# Supportive Stranger

> Supportive Stranger is an iPhone app for short, private reflection. You write up to 100 words about what is on your mind; an anonymous AI "stranger" replies with warmth (no judgment, no advice) and turns your words into an illustrated scene with your chosen character in it. In "Dark thoughts – Reflect & release" mode you then write what you would tell yourself (about 30 characters) and tap the image twice to crack and shatter it. In "Neutral notes – Save & keep" mode you simply save the moment. No account; the journal is stored only on the iPhone. One free reflection; then a Reflection Package of 30 reflections valid for 60 days (e.g. €14.99 in Germany), no subscription. A wellness tool, not a medical device, therapy or crisis service. Age 17+. English only.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/supportive-stranger/id6760293353?l=en-GB
- Website: https://supportive-stranger-app.com
- Privacy Policy: https://supportive-stranger-app.com/#privacy-policy-app
